runbook_load.name: hotel/filter
runbook_load.goal: Find a stay in Lisbon in the Design category with free cancellation, then open the page for Casa Flora. Stop on that page.

steps.instruction: Enter Lisbon as the Destination and press Find stays
hints: A typed destination is not applied until Find stays is pressed.
Stays are listed before any search. Do not open any of them until the last step.
steps.done_when: The result count reads "places in Lisbon". Stays listed before the search do not count.

steps.instruction: Set the category filter to Design
hints: Change the filters only after the result count reads "places in Lisbon".

steps.instruction: Turn on the Free cancellation filter
hints: Do not click it again if it is already on.
steps.done_when: Free cancellation is shown as on

steps.instruction: Open the page for Casa Flora
steps.done_when: The page heading is Casa Flora

info.description: A local stay search: enter a destination, search, filter the results, and open a stay's page.

pages.purpose: Search form, filters, and the result list on one page

regions.purpose: Category and Free cancellation filters, the result list, and a stay's page
Site-wide links (Find a stay, Reading room)

The result count reads "places in <city>" only after a search.
Filters (category, Free cancellation) apply to the current result list.
